questions: Did you remain conscious throughout the fall?
Did you feel faint or lightheaded immediately before you fell?
Did you experience spinning or a loss of balance before falling?
Did you have chest pain, palpitations, or shortness of breath before falling?
Did you suddenly lose strength in both legs?
Did one side of your body become weak or numb?
Did you have difficulty speaking, seeing, or understanding immediately before or after the fall?
Did you have jerking movements, tongue biting, or loss of bladder control?
Did you injure your head or lose consciousness after hitting the floor?
Have you had similar falls before?
Do these falls occur only when you are standing or walking?
Do you feel a warning before most of these falls?
Can you stand and walk normally when you are alone?
Have you recently started or changed any medications?
Have you had fever, vomiting, diarrhea, poor fluid intake, or bleeding recently?

Alternative: Cataplexy

Alternative: Atonic epileptic seizures
